message: 本当は遠回り

name: Synn
message: 「One day left until the test... Man, my feet feel so heavy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't blame ya. Between exam studyin', patrols, day-and-night trainin', tendin' the garden, and helpin' at the shopping district, you're gonna keel over from lack of sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't have to deliver milk anymore, so I've been able to sleep in.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just that on this test... I might not be able to take first place... I might lose my scholarship status...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a second. Thinking of it as one day away is what makes it feel so stressful.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! If I reframe it as 24 hours away... no, 1,440 minutes away... no, 86,400 seconds away, that should give me plenty of breathing room!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's just study.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? What are you doing at my place... Are we having another study session today?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's your problem?! I was just passing by on my way back from shopping!」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a public road, isn't it?! I didn't come here to see you, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you've got Capricore shopping bags in both hands, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly! Hello, and goodbye!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Goodbye.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She took off already, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I never thought I'd run into Misa by coincidence like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helping out with the shopping even though it's the day before the test. Misa sure is admirable.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell that's it. Do you even know where she lives?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't? Somewhere in the residential district, probably.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why would someone who lives over there pass by a spot like this on the way back from the shopping district?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff, huff!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? Did you drop something?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You forgot something! Here!!」
Misa thrusts a plastic shopping bag at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Come on... take it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, so you want me to carry half your bags and walk you home... Is that how I should interpret this?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, you idiot! There's nothing in it but snacks, so there's no way it's heavy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, chocolates, mini daifuku, sesame cookies, brown sugar karinto, and all sorts of other stuff.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it's packed to the brim with the absolute best snacks for fueling brainwork.」

name: Misa
message: 「And today is the day before the test. So... here!!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-C-C-Could it be you're giving this to me!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you getting so flustered? You have every right to receive this, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure? Sorry to make you go out of your way to be so kind.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-Why on earth would I have to be considerate toward you, Sakura-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you getting all worked up?」

name: Misa
message: 「I am completely calm and composed! Take a good look!」

name: Misa
message: 「The bag I'm holding has the exact same snacks in it. When your brain gets tired, you eat something sweet and keep studying.」

name: Misa
message: 「You and me! If we don't prepare for the test under equal conditions and compete over the results, it wouldn't be a fair match, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「...J-Just take it already...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thank you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sei--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, don't get ahead of yourself! Now we're even--I'm no coward!」

name: Synn
message: 「Normally, I'd stretch these snacks out to last a whole week, but.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't stretch them out, don't!」

name: Synn
message: 「This time I'll go ahead and eat them over a single night while studying for my tests.」
